section.title: Technical Product Leadership
section.intro: From software engineering foundations to leading product direction, organizational execution, and complex B2B SaaS platform delivery.

groups.title: Technical Foundation
groups.subtitle: Senior Web Programmer / Web Developer / WordPress Developer
groups.summary: Built the engineering foundation that now informs product leadership and technical decision-making, progressing from implementation-focused development into senior technical ownership across backend systems, frontend engineering, APIs, and platform infrastructure.

items.summary: Built product structure and execution discipline, defined product direction, and transformed a fragmented Transportation Management System into a production-live B2B platform validated by 10 beta carrier companies.

details.title: Organizational Leadership
items: Led a 40-person cross-functional execution organization across frontend, backend, mobile, QA, and design.
Partnered directly with the CEO on product direction, execution priorities, and organizational decision-making.
Held full people management responsibility, including hiring, performance management, disciplinary actions, compensation decisions, and execution quality.
Built execution discipline through regular leadership alignment, delivery oversight, and team performance management.

details.title: Product Strategy
items: Inherited a fragmented multi-year product effort and redefined it into a cohesive MVP-ready B2B SaaS platform.
Owned MVP definition, Version 1 scope, roadmap direction, prioritization, release readiness, and launch decision-making.
Contributed to pricing, billing architecture, subscription logic, and monetization decisions.

details.title: Technical Product Leadership
items: Led technical product decisions across backend, web, mobile, APIs, integrations, and operational workflows.
Collaborated with engineering leadership on architecture discussions, technical feasibility, implementation trade-offs, and execution planning.
Evaluated implementation direction for mobile technical decisions, including geofence-related solutions.

details.title: Execution & Delivery
items: Led execution across engineering, QA, design, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
Worked directly with beta customers through demos, validation sessions, interviews, and structured feedback loops.
Built prioritization frameworks, requirement standards, release processes, and delivery discipline.

details.title: Platform & Integrations
items: Owned product direction across dispatch, loads, payroll, billing, authentication, OCR workflows, and operational platform modules.
Directed external technical integrations including ELD/API/vendor evaluations and engineering coordination.

items.summary: Led technical product delivery and roadmap execution across revenue-critical engineering teams supporting affiliate marketing infrastructure and internal monetization platforms.

details.title: Technical Product Delivery
items: Led technical product delivery across distributed engineering teams (11 cross-functional team members) responsible for revenue-critical affiliate marketing and ad-tech platforms.
Shared product decision-making and prioritization ownership with business stakeholders in commercially sensitive delivery environments.
Translated complex stakeholder requirements into structured execution plans that improved delivery clarity and decision-making.

details.title: Product Platforms
items: Managed delivery of a custom affiliate management platform used to create, configure, and track affiliate links, banners, and monetization assets across large-scale publishing operations.
Led development of a React-based internal ad-tech platform enabling business teams to configure campaigns, display logic, targeting rules, modal behavior, and click analytics.

details.title: Stakeholder & Commercial Leadership
items: Partnered with 5+ stakeholder leads across 3 commercial teams, translating business objectives into structured engineering execution plans and delivery priorities.
Worked across deadline-sensitive commercial environments where execution decisions directly impacted revenue-critical operations.

details.title: Execution Leadership
items: Coordinated cross-functional delivery across WordPress, React, QA, design, and engineering teams.
Led sprint planning, scope definition, feasibility assessment, release readiness, and roadmap execution across concurrent platform initiatives.
Translated complex business requirements into structured technical execution plans that improved clarity and accelerated decision-making.

items.summary: Started in a traditional Scrum Master role during a large-scale organizational Agile transformation, evolving into broader product and delivery leadership responsibilities across revenue-critical affiliate monetization and ad-tech platforms.

details.title: Delivery Leadership
items: Led Agile delivery across 2 Scrum teams (9 developers + 2 Product Owners) supporting revenue-critical affiliate monetization and ad-tech platforms.
Improved execution discipline, prioritization clarity, backlog quality, release readiness, and delivery effectiveness across multiple cross-functional teams.

details.title: Platform Scale
items: Supported development of a content operations platform used by a 50+ member internal commercial organization to manage partner offers, campaign data, and monetization workflows.
Enabled delivery of API-driven infrastructure serving monetization data to approximately 3000 WordPress websites across enterprise-scale publishing operations.

details.title: Transformation & Modernization
items: Led Agile execution during a large-scale organizational transformation while helping establish more predictable delivery practices across teams.
Led execution for an ad-tech modernization initiative supporting a 15-member AdTech organization, replacing a legacy JavaScript banner workflow with a scalable internal management platform.

details.title: Commercial Impact
items: Contributed to delivery of systems supporting business functions responsible for approximately 25–30% of company revenue.
Worked closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders in commercially sensitive delivery environments.

items.summary: Developed and maintained affiliate monetization infrastructure supporting approximately 3000 WordPress publishing properties across large-scale digital media operations.
Delivered frontend and WordPress platform development across revenue-driven publishing operations, contributing to architecture consistency, implementation quality, and scalable feature delivery.
Built and maintained production web properties in a high-scale affiliate publishing environment, supporting frontend delivery, content systems, and performance-focused implementations.
Developed and maintained production web experiences across WordPress-based publishing platforms, building practical expertise in scalable frontend delivery and content-driven product environments.
Delivered web development implementations across client-oriented projects, building early foundations in frontend engineering, backend integrations, and production delivery practices.
Started professional engineering work across WordPress development and frontend implementation, building the technical foundation that later evolved into platform engineering and product leadership.
Archived early support leadership role retained in JSON for future use.
